blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Role prompting elicits specialized behavior from large language models through an expert identity, offering a lightweight way to guide reasoning on demanding tasks. However, evaluating or distilling complete role-prompted answers can miss useful next-token preferences when the sampled solution remains incorrect. Transferring these preferences also requires an objective that reaches alternatives the student rarely predicts. We introduce OPSRD , which uses a fixed expert role as privileged teaching context for on-policy self-distillation without reference solutions. A role-free student generates a trajectory, and a frozen instance of the same base model supplies role-conditioned distributions on its exact prefixes, exposing alternatives beyond the sampled continuation. Teacher-weighted forward KL targets alternatives the student underestimates, with clipping to limit individual vocabulary contributions. Supervision is restricted to the highest-entropy half of student positions, concentrating learning where predictions are uncertain. Experiments on three competition-math benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B show improvements over the base models without role prompts at inference. Forward KL achieves the highest macro-averaged accuracy among the three evaluated divergences at every scale . Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/OPSRD .
blocks.zh: 角色激励通过专家身份从大型语言模型中引来专门行为,提供了一种轻量级的方法来指导对艰巨任务的推理. 然而,当抽样解决方案仍然不正确时,评价或提炼完整的角色提示解答可能会错失有用的下键首选项. 转让这些偏好还需要达到学生很少预测的目标。 我们提出OPSRD,它使用固定的专家角色作为没有参考解决办法的政策自我消化的特权教学背景。 无角色学生产生轨迹,同一基模的冷冻实例在其准确的前缀上提供角色条件分布,暴露出超出被抽样续作的替代品. 教师加权前方KL针对学生低估的其他选择,并进行剪辑以限制个人的词汇贡献。 监督限于学生中身处最高一半的职位,集中在预测不确定的地方学习。 以Qune3–1.7B,4B,8B三个竞争-马思基准进行的实验显示,比基模型有所改进,没有角色提示推论. Forward KL在每个尺度上的三个评价差异中达到最高的宏观平均准确度。 代码见https://github.com/zhansan114514/OPSRD 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models serve as general-purpose assistants for reasoning, explanation, and problem solving. Their usefulness depends on how instructions elicit the capabilities needed for a particular task ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . Role prompting makes this dependence explicit by asking a model to adopt an expert identity ( Xu et al., 2023 ) . A mathematical expert role can request careful derivations and verification, while a critic role can encourage checking intermediate conclusions. Such prompts offer a practical way to guide model behavior without changing its parameters.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型是用于推理、解释和解决问题的通用助手。 其效用取决于指示如何产生特定任务所需的能力(Liu等人,2023年)。 激发这种依赖性的作用是明确要求一个模型采用专家身份(徐等人,2023年)。 数学专家的作用可以要求仔细推论和核实,而批评者的作用可以鼓励检查中间结论。 这种提示提供了在不改变其参数的情况下指导模型行为的实际方法.

blocks.en: However, existing uses of role prompting often assess expertise through complete generated responses. Reported reasoning gains and failures ( Kong et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) therefore mix the role’s local influence with the effects of sampling an entire solution. A useful next-token preference can remain unsampled or be followed by a later mistake. Distilling expert-prompted responses ( Xu et al., 2023 ) likewise transfers only the sampled continuations. On-policy self-distillation accesses richer token distributions, but solution-conditioned OPSD derives its teaching advantage from a reference solution for each problem ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . The open question is whether an expert role can supervise the student’s reasoning even when its complete answers offer no measured advantage .
blocks.zh: 然而,现有作用的利用往往通过完整的对策来评估专门知识。 因此,所报告的推理得失(Kong等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年)将角色的局部影响与采样整个解决方案的效果混为一谈。 一种有用的邻接偏好可以保持不变,或随后出现错误。 稀释专家提出的答复(徐等人,2023年)同样只转移抽样的延续。 政策上的自我消化可以获取更丰富的符号分配,但基于解决方案的OPSD从每个问题的参考解决方案中获得了教学优势(Zhao等人,2026年)。 问题在于专家角色能否监督学生的推理,

blocks.en: Our starting observation is a negative result. On three competition-math benchmarks, adding an expert olympiad mathematician role to Qwen3-1.7B changes macro accuracy from 35.74 to 34.54, providing no measured improvement over the ordinary prompt. A neutral system instruction reaches the same score. The expert label alone is insufficient to improve sampled solutions in this setting. What remains unobserved is the role-conditioned distribution at each intermediate choice, before later decisions determine the final answer.
blocks.zh: 我们的开始观察是一个负面的结果。 在三个竞争-马思基准上,在Qwen3-1.7B中增加一个专家的奥林匹亚数学家角色,将宏观精度从35.74修改为34.54,与普通的速率相比没有提供量度的改进. 中性系统指令达到相同的分数. 仅靠专家标签不足以改进这一背景下的抽样解决办法。 仍未观察到的是,在以后的决定确定最后答案之前,在每一个中间选择中,角色有条件的分配。

blocks.en: We hypothesize that a role-conditioned model can teach useful next-token preferences even when its complete solutions offer no accuracy gain. Under this hypothesis, the role’s value lies in shifting probability toward helpful continuations at uncertain student prefixes. Holding these prefixes fixed lets the teacher evaluate the choices the student actually faces. On-policy distillation provides this alignment ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) , allowing us to test a reusable role as privileged teaching context without per-problem reference solutions.
blocks.zh: 我们假设,一个有作用条件的模型即使其完全的解决方案没有准确性收益,也能教授有用的下一个偏好。 根据这个假设,角色的价值在于在不确定的学生前缀中将概率转向有益的延续。 持有这些前缀固定让老师评价学生实际面临的选择. 政策上的提炼提供了这种一致性(Agarwal等人,2024年;Gu等人,2024年),让我们可以测试作为特权教学背景的可重复使用的作用,而无需每个问题参考解决方案。

blocks.en: We develop OPSRD to test this hypothesis. The student generates trajectories under its ordinary prompt. A frozen instance of the same base model receives the expert role and scores the exact student prefixes, supplying a distribution over possible next tokens. We retain the highest-entropy half of student positions to focus supervision on uncertain choices. Only a low-rank student adapter is updated ( Hu et al., 2022 ) ; the teacher stays fixed, no reference answer enters training, and the trained student uses its ordinary prompt at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们开发OPSRD来测试这个假设. 学生在其普通的提示下产生轨迹. 同一基模的冷冻实例得到专家角色,并得分准确的学生前缀,提供对可能的下一个符号的分布. 我们保留了学生中最高的一半职位,以集中监督不确定的选择。 只有低级学生适配器才更新(Hu等人,2022年);教师保持固定,没有参考答案进入培训,受训学生使用普通的即时推论.

blocks.en: For this feedback to help, the objective must reach alternatives the student currently underestimates. A reverse-KL update weakens as the student’s probability of an alternative approaches zero, even when the teacher supports it. Forward KL weights the target by teacher probability and directly corrects this underestimation before clipping. We therefore use forward KL, with a cap on individual vocabulary contributions to limit large discrepancies from an imperfect teacher. We compare forward KL, reverse KL, and Jensen–Shannon divergence under the same role and entropy mask.
blocks.zh: 为了使这种反馈有所帮助,目标必须达到学生目前低估的其他选择。 反向 KL 更新会因为学生选择机会的概率接近零而减弱,即使老师支持。 前进 KL 按老师概率对目标进行加权,并在剪辑前直接纠正这一低估. 因此,我们使用向前的KL,对单个词汇贡献加以限制,以限制与不完善教师的巨大差异。 我们比较前置KL,反向KL,以及Jensen–Shannon在相同角色和 en面罩下的差异.

blocks.en: Experiments cover Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on three competition-math benchmarks. Forward KL achieves the highest macro accuracy among the evaluated divergences at all three scales (Figure 3 ). At 1.7B, OPSRD improves Base by 6.30 percentage points in the primary run, and independent training repeats retain the gain. Placement controls favor keeping the role in the teacher. The study contributes an empirical contrast between direct prompting and role-based supervision, an answer-free on-policy method, and an analysis of how divergence and role placement govern this transfer.
blocks.zh: 实验范围包括Qwen3-1.7B,4B,以及8B三个竞技场比分. 前进 KL 在所有三个尺度上的评价差异中达到最高的宏精确度(图 3 )。 在1.7B时,OPSRD有所改进 初赛以6.30个百分点为基础,独立训练留级保留了收益. 位置控制有利于保持角色在老师。 该研究在直接激励和基于作用的监督、无答政策方法以及分析差异和作用定位如何指导这种转移之间提供了经验对比。

The highest-entropy half of student positions receive clipped, full-vocabulary forward KL. Only student LoRA parameters are updated, and deployment uses the ordinary prompt at test time.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 On-Policy Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.1 政策扭曲

blocks.en: On-policy distillation learns from student-generated trajectories, with the teacher evaluating the same prefixes ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) . Sequence-level distillation instead trains on teacher-generated outputs ( Kim & Rush, 2016 ) . Using student prefixes addresses the train–test distribution mismatch central to imitation learning ( Ross et al., 2011 ) . The teacher supplies distributional supervision ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) , while the student determines where it applies. Generalized knowledge distillation permits different divergences, and MiniLLM uses reverse KL. Entropy-aware OPD adds forward KL when teacher entropy is high ( Jin et al., 2026 ) , linking the objective to teacher uncertainty .
blocks.zh: 政策性蒸馏学从学生生成的轨迹中学习,由老师评价相同的前缀(Agarwal等人,2024年;Gu等人,2024年). 序列级蒸馏换成在师生产出上进行训练(Kim & Rush,2016). 使用学生前缀解决列车-测试分布错配对于模仿学习至关重要(Ross等人,2011年). 教师提供配送监督(Hinton等人,2015年),学生则决定其应用地点. 通用的知识蒸馏允许不同的差异,MiniLLM使用反向KL. Entropy-aware OPD 在教师的Entropy值较高时添加了KL(Jin等人,2026年),将目标与教师的不确定性联系起来.

blocks.en: The quality of feedback also depends on the prefixes the student visits. Speculative knowledge distillation lets the teacher replace poorly ranked student proposals, bringing the sampled trajectory closer to teacher-supported continuations ( Xu et al., 2025 ) . Other methods adjust the learning signal at a fixed prefix. Asymmetric OPD combines positive reinforcement with local divergence minimization ( Jia et al., 2026 ) , while empirical analyses identify unreliable teacher guidance and imbalanced token supervision as failure modes ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . CROP selects positions using counterfactual task relevance ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and spurious-signal filtering uses input dependence together with divergence to remove misleading updates ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . This work establishes that visiting student states alone does not make every teacher preference equally useful.
blocks.zh: 反馈的质量也取决于学生访问的前缀. 投机性知识蒸馏让教师取代排名差的学生建议,使抽样的轨迹更接近教师支持的续作(徐等人,2025年). 其他方法在固定前缀时调整学习信号. 不对称的OPD结合了正面强化和局部差异最小化(Jia等人,2026年),而经验分析则将不可靠的教师指导和不平衡的象征性监督确定为失败模式(Fu等人,2026年). CROP使用反事实任务关联性选择位置(Li等人,2026年),虚构的信号过滤使用输入依赖性与分歧一起去除误导性更新(Jiang等人,2026年). 这项工作规定,光是访问学生的州并不能使每个教师偏好都同样有用。

blocks.en: Self-distillation changes where the teacher’s advantage comes from. Earlier approaches learn from model-generated reasoning, instructions, or filtered outputs ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Gulcehre et al., 2023 ) . OPSD uses one model under two contexts: its teacher sees a privileged solution and evaluates the question-only student’s rollouts ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . This supplies token-level feedback without a separately pretrained teacher. OPSRD builds on this contextual asymmetry, replacing the per-problem solution with a reusable expert role and asking how to transfer that weaker source of supervision.
blocks.zh: 自我消化会改变教师的优势所在。 早期的方法借鉴了模型产生的推理、说明或过滤输出(Zelikman等人,2022年;Wang等人,2023年;Gulcehre等人,2023年)。 OPSD在两种情况下使用一种模式:其老师看到一种特权解决方案,评价只问学生的推出(赵等人,2026年). 这可以提供代号级反馈,而无需经过单独事先培训的老师. OPSRD以这种背景不对称为基础,用可重复使用的专家角色取代每个问题的解决办法,并询问如何转移这一较弱的监督来源。

blocks.en: 2.2 Role-Conditioned Supervision
blocks.zh: 2.2 作用监督

blocks.en: Prompts can expose behavior that a model does not reliably express under an ordinary instruction. ExpertPrompting constructs an expert identity for each instruction, uses it to generate responses, and trains ExpertLLaMA on the resulting data ( Xu et al., 2023 ) . Role-play prompting also improves selected reasoning tasks ( Kong et al., 2024 ) , and RoleLLM studies how to elicit and train broader role-playing abilities ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . Controlled experiments find that persona prompts can impair reasoning as well as help it ( Kim et al., 2024 ) . The question for distillation is consequently how a role’s influence should be measured and transferred when its complete sampled answers offer an uncertain advantage.
blocks.zh: 提示可以揭示一个模型在普通指令下不能可靠表达的行为. 专家Prompting为每个指令构建了一个专家身份,用它来生成响应,并培训专家LelaMA了解由此产生的数据(徐等人,2023年)。 角色扮演激励还改进了部分推理任务(Kong等人,2024年),角色LLM研究如何引领和训练更广泛的角色扮演能力(Wang等人,2024年). 受控制的实验发现,个人的诱因既会损害推理,也会帮助推理(Kim等人,2024年)。 因此,要提炼的问题是,当一个角色的全部抽样答复提供不确定的优势时,如何衡量和转让其影响。

blocks.en: Context distillation provides a bridge from conditional behavior to learned behavior by internalizing gains elicited by instructions and scratchpads ( Snell et al., 2022 ) . In-context learning distillation transfers the ability to learn from demonstrations ( Huang et al., 2022 ) , and self-distillation can reduce distribution gaps during fine-tuning ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . These studies show several ways that a model’s context can create a teaching signal. For a role teacher, the relevant signal may lie in its preferences among possible next tokens on an existing student prefix. Capturing these preferences gives access to guidance that a comparison of complete role-prompted solutions can miss.
blocks.zh: 环境蒸馏提供了从有条件行为到学习行为的桥梁,通过内化指令和刮伤得到的收益(Snell等人,2022年)。 内容内学习蒸馏转移了从演示中学习的能力(黄等人,2022年),自我消化可以在微调时减少分布差距(杨等人,2024年). 这些研究表明,模型的背景可以产生教学信号的几种方式。 对于一个角色老师来说,相关的信号可能在于其偏好,在现有的学生前缀上可能包含下一个符号. 抓住这些偏好就可以获得指导,对完整角色引发的解决方案进行比较可能会错过。

blocks.en: In OPSRD , a single role supplies context for a teacher that shares the student’s base model. The teacher scores role-free student prefixes, and entropy selection concentrates forward-KL supervision on uncertain positions. This makes the role’s distributional feedback the object of distillation while keeping student generation under the ordinary prompt.
blocks.zh: 在OPSRD中,一个单一的角色为一个分享学生基础模式的教师提供背景. 老师对无角色学生前缀的评分,以及Entropy选择将前置-KL监督集中在不确定的位置上. 这使得角色的分布反馈成为蒸馏的对象,同时让学生的产生处于普通的快速状态.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Our experiments test whether an expert role can provide useful supervision when it offers little benefit as a direct prompt. We first compare role distillation with prompting and answer-conditioned distillation, then examine the choices that govern the transfer. Repeated training and evaluation assess the stability of the gains, and a problem-level analysis shows how those gains change the student’s answers .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验测试专家作用能否提供有益的监督,而这种作用作为直接的推动作用却没有什么好处。 我们首先将角色蒸馏与催化和解答条件蒸馏进行比较,然后审查指导转移的选择. 反复的培训和评价评估了收益的稳定性,并进行了问题层面的分析,说明这些收益如何改变学生的答案。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , with a frozen instance of each base model serving as its own teacher. Training uses the 29,434-example mathematical split derived from OpenThoughts ( Guha et al., 2026 ) . All methods train a rank-64 LoRA adapter for 100 optimizer steps with learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} and effective batch size 36. The student samples one rollout per problem, capped at 1,024 tokens. We use 1.7B for the detailed ablations and independent training repeats; the larger models test whether the recipe remains useful as base accuracy increases. Appendix A gives the remaining hyperparameters and exact prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 Quen3-1.7B, 4B, 和 8B( Yang et al., 2025), 每个基模的冰冻实例作为自己的老师。 训练使用OpenThoughts(Guha等人,2026年)衍生出来的29,434-实例数学分裂. 所有方法都训练一个等级-64的LORA适配器,用于100个最优化的步数,学习率5×10−6 5\times 10×6}有效批量大小36. 学生们对每个问题做一个样本,封顶为1,024令牌. 我们使用1.7B来进行详细的拼贴和独立训练重复;较大的模型来测试配方是否随着基础精度的提高仍然有用. 附 录 A给出了剩下的超参数和准确的提示.

blocks.en: We evaluate on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025, each containing 30 problems. Every problem receives 12 samples at temperature 1.0 and top- p p 0.95, with a 38,912-token generation cap. We report average sample accuracy for each task and its unweighted macro average, denoted Avg ​ @ ​ 12 \mathrm{Avg@12} . All comparisons use the final step-100 checkpoint and the ordinary evaluation prompt unless a prompt change is the intervention being tested. Reported 95% intervals use paired problem-level bootstrap resampling, with the training repeats additionally accounting for shared test problems. Appendix D defines these estimators.
blocks.zh: 我们评价AIME 2024,AIME 2025,以及HMMT 2025年2月,各包含30个问题. 每个问题在温度1.0和最高点0.95时都收到12个样本,并有38,912个托肯生成盖. 我们报告每个任务的平均样本精度及其未加权的宏平均值,表示 Avg @ 12\mathrm{Avg@12} 。 所有比较都使用最后一步-100检查站和普通评价即时,除非正在测试的干预措施是迅速改变。 报告95%的间隔使用对齐的问题级靴子重新取样,训练会额外说明共同的测试问题。 附录D界定了这些估计值。

blocks.en: Base is the untrained model. Direct expert and neutral prompting test whether an extra system message improves inference by itself. Answer OPSD supplies a reference solution to the teacher, following Zhao et al. (2026) , and provides the main training baseline. Role full and Neutral full distill an expert or generic teacher instruction at every valid position. OPSRD combines the expert teacher with the highest-entropy half of student positions. This set of comparisons connects the practical benefit of role distillation to the teacher context, role placement, and training objective.
blocks.zh: 基地是未经训练的模型. 直接的专家和中性提示测试一个额外的系统消息本身是否改善推论. Answer OPSD为老师提供了参考解决方案,跟随赵等人(2026年),并提供主要的培训基线. 在每一个有效位置上,角色完全和中立地充分提炼一名专家或一般教师的教导。 OPSRD将专家教师与学生职位中最高的半数结合起来. 这套比较将角色提炼的实际好处与教师背景、角色安排和培训目标联系起来。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

Direct expert prompting gives 34.54 macro accuracy, close to the 35.74 Base score, and the paired difference has an interval of [ − 4.35 , 1.94 ] [-4.35,1.94] . Using that role for the teacher raises accuracy to 40.09 with full distillation and 42.04 with OPSRD (Table 1 ). The latter improves Base by 6.30 ​ pp 6.30\,\mathrm{pp} , with interval [ 3.24 , 9.54 ] [3.24,9.54] , and Answer OPSD by 3.33 ​ pp 3.33\,\mathrm{pp} , with interval [ 0.83 , 6.02 ] [0.83,6.02] . The teacher receives the same short instruction for every training example, making the supervision reusable across problems without their reference solutions.

blocks.en: The benchmark results clarify this change. Direct prompting lowers HMMT accuracy while leaving the two AIME scores near Base. After distillation, all three task point estimates improve, with the largest gain on AIME 2024. The role’s failure to raise aggregate prompting accuracy therefore does not preclude useful feedback on the student’s prefixes. The placement and divergence ablations below examine how that feedback reaches the trained model.
blocks.zh: 基准结果澄清了这一变化。 直接提示降低HMMT的精度,同时将两个AIME分数留在Base附近. 经过蒸馏,三个任务点估计都有所改善,在AIME 2024上收益最大. 因此,该角色未能提高总的激发准确性并不排除对学生前缀的有益反馈。 下文的定位和差异分析审查了这种反馈如何到达训练有素的模式。

blocks.en: Table 2 extends the comparison to stronger base models. OPSRD improves macro accuracy at all three scales, with gains of 6.30, 1.67, and 3.06 points over Base. The 4B entry averages four evaluations of each fixed checkpoint; the other scales use the primary evaluation. The gains are smaller as baseline accuracy rises, although their magnitude does not change monotonically with model size. Across these summaries, role distillation also exceeds the answer-conditioned comparator while requiring less privileged training context.

Averaging the repeated 4B evaluations changes the overall ordering. Role distillation remains useful across model sizes, while the strength of its advantage depends on the benchmark and evaluation sample. Appendix C provides the complete benchmark scores, and Section 4.4 assesses variation across all four repeated evaluations.
blocks.zh: 每个任务比较显示出对教师背景的不同偏好. Answer OPSD拥有最强的4B初级评价,并在8B AIME 2025上略高于OPSRD. 重复进行的4B评价改变了总体顺序。 角色蒸馏在模型大小上仍然有用,而其优势的强度取决于基准和评价样本. 附 录 C节提供了完整的基准分数,第4.4节评估了所有四次重复评价的差异。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: We first ask how much of the benefit requires an expert instruction. Neutral full improves Base by 2.50 points, showing that a generic teacher context already supplies useful self-distillation feedback. Role full adds 1.85 points over this control, with interval [ − 0.28 , 3.98 ] [-0.28,3.98] . The combined OPSRD recipe is 3.80 points above Neutral full, with interval [ 1.20 , 6.39 ] [1.20,6.39] . These results motivate the expert context, while the missing neutral-teacher 50% control leaves its contribution at the selected positions unresolved. The remaining ablations hold the expert instruction fixed and test how to transfer its feedback.
blocks.zh: 我们首先问,需要专家指导的惠益有多少。 中性全面改进 以2.50分为基础,显示通用的教师背景已经提供了有用的自我消化反馈. 角色满分比此控制增加1.85分,间隔[−0.28,3.98] [-0.28,3.98]. 组合的OPSRD配方为中性全高3.80分,间隔[1.20,6.39] [1.20,6.39]. 这些结果激发了专家的情绪,而缺少中性教师的50%控制则使其在选定的职位上的贡献得不到解决。 其余部分将固定专家指示,并测试如何传递其反馈。

blocks.en: The role can change either the student’s trajectory or the teacher’s view of it. To distinguish these effects, we place the role in the teacher, the student, or both, holding the model size, selection fraction, checkpoint, and evaluation protocol fixed. Each trained model is then evaluated with and without the role. This comparison tests the division of labor in OPSRD , where the student chooses the trajectory and the teacher supplies the additional perspective.
blocks.zh: 该角色既可以改变学生的轨迹,也可以改变教师对此的看法。 为了区分这些效果,我们把角色放在老师,学生,或两者,同时将模型大小,选择分数,检查点,评价协议固定下来. 然后对每一个经过培训的模型进行评价,并附带或不附带这一角色。 校对:Soup

blocks.en: The next comparison tests how the student should absorb the role teacher’s distribution. We replace forward KL with reverse KL or JSD while retaining the expert teacher and 50% entropy mask. Forward KL gives the highest macro accuracy at all three scales (Figure 3 ). The clearest separation is at 1.7B, where it exceeds reverse KL by 4.81 points with interval [ 2.41 , 7.31 ] [2.41,7.31] . This result agrees with the motivation in Section 3 : teacher-supported alternatives receive a direct learning signal even when the student assigns them little probability.
blocks.zh: 接下来的比较测试学生应如何吸收角色教师的分布. 我们用反向 KL 或 JSD 来取代前置 KL , 同时保留专家老师和50% 的内膜。 前进 KL 在所有三个尺度上给出最高的宏精确度(图 3 ). 最清楚的分离地点是1.7B,它比逆KL高出4.81分,间隔[2.41,7.31][2.41,7.31]. 这一结果与第3节的动机一致:即使学生分配的概率很小,教师支持的替代方法也会得到直接的学习信号。

blocks.en: The larger-model gaps are less conclusive. Forward-minus-reverse intervals cross zero at 4B and 8B, and reverse KL is stronger on 4B AIME 2024. We therefore use forward KL as the default supported most clearly by the primary scale. All divergence variants have one training run; JSD also differs in hardware and is supported by saved aggregate scores. Appendix C.2 gives the objective definitions, full task results, and comparison settings. The 4B result in this figure uses the primary evaluation, whereas Table 2 summarizes the repeated evaluations.

blocks.en: Finally, we test whether the gain survives concentrating supervision on uncertain positions. Selecting half the valid positions raises the primary score by 1.94 points over Role full, with interval [ − 0.56 , 4.44 ] [-0.56,4.44] . blocks.en: An increase in average accuracy can reflect more reliable solutions to familiar problems or successful attempts on previously unsolved ones. We distinguish these outcomes by pairing Base and OPSRD on every test problem. Figure 4 shows that OPSRD increases the 12-sample success rate on 38 problems and lowers it on 12, with the rest tied. The improvements are most widespread on AIME 2024. This pattern accounts for the stronger AIME gains in the aggregate comparison and the repeated-training summary.

blocks.en: This distinction connects the evaluation to the training design. OPSRD learns on student-generated prefixes, so useful feedback must act within trajectories the student actually visits. blocks.en: We also check whether the primary improvement can be explained by output failures. blocks.zh: 我们还检查能否用产出失败来解释主要改进。 格式遵守率在主要条件下超过99%,Base和OPSRD都很少达到生成上限. 新增的68个正确的代数超过了畸形和近顶级产出的差异. 这些差异太小,无法单独解释收益,支持以下解释,即观察到的变化涉及在共享的长式评价预算中回答准确性。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: The experiments connect the role’s placement to the distribution it teaches. Direct prompting changes the student’s trajectory from its first token. Teacher-only distillation instead evaluates the trajectory the student already produced, and the placement controls favor keeping these two functions separate. Forward KL weights the update by the teacher’s probabilities, allowing teacher-supported alternatives to receive a learning signal even when the student rarely predicts them. Equation 7 describes this behavior before clipping, while Appendix B gives the gradient of the implemented objective. Tracking those alternatives through training would test how this local signal produces the observed answer-level gains. Both full and selective distillation improve Base across training seeds. Their paired interval crosses zero, so the selection result supports retaining the benefit at half the supervised positions. The implementation still requires both full forward passes.
blocks.zh: 实验将角色的定位与其教导的分布联系起来. 直接提示改变学生的轨迹, 而只靠教师的蒸馏则评价了学生已经产生的轨迹,安置控制了将这两种功能分开的倾向. Forward KL 以老师的概率来加权更新,即使学生很少预测,也允许教师支持的替代品接收学习信号. 方程式7在剪辑前描述了这种行为,而附录B给出了已实现目标的梯度. 通过培训跟踪这些替代办法,将检验这种当地信号如何产生所观察到的答案层面的收益。 全面蒸馏和选择性蒸馏改进了整个培训种子的基础。 它们的配对间隔跨越0,因此选择结果支持将福利保留在被监管职位的一半. 执行工作仍需要两张完整的前进通行证。

blocks.en: The evidence covers one model family, one mathematical training corpus, three competition benchmarks, and a matched 1.7B-to-8B scale suite. Three training seeds do not characterize every source of optimization variance. Evaluating other model families and tasks would test the broader reach of this training recipe.
blocks.zh: 证据包括一个模范家庭、一个数学培训教材、三个竞争基准和一个匹配的1.7B至8B比例套房。 三种训练种子并不是每个优化差异来源的特点。 评价其他示范家庭和任务将检验这种培训方法的更广泛范围。

blocks.en: OPSRD turns a fixed expert role into supervision along the student’s own reasoning. A frozen instance of the same base model provides the teacher distribution, and the student learns from it through forward KL at uncertain positions. Across the three tested scales, forward KL achieves the highest macro score among the evaluated divergences, with the clearest advantage over reverse KL at 1.7B. Training-seed repeats retain the gain over Base, and the trained student solves problems with an ordinary prompt. A role can therefore be useful even when direct prompting offers no measured improvement. Its teaching value lies in the guidance it supplies along the student’s reasoning.
blocks.zh: PSRD将固定的专家角色转化为学生自身推理的监督. 同一基模型的冰冻实例提供了教师分布,学生通过前方KL在不确定位置学习. 在三个测试尺度上,前方KL在所评估的差异中达到最高的宏观分数,比逆方KL在1.7B的优势最明显. 训练-种子重复保留了对Base的增益,受训学生以普通的即时方式解决问题. 因此,即使直接促动不能带来有分寸的改进,角色也可以有用。 它的教学价值在于它按照学生的推理提供的指导。

blocks.en: Appendix E Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录E 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: The experiments use public mathematical problems and model-generated reasoning, with no human subjects or private records. Expertise labels require task-specific validation before deployment because a role can change model behavior unpredictably. Training uses student and teacher forward passes, while inference uses only the adapted student and its ordinary prompt.
blocks.zh: 这些实验使用了公共数学问题和模型生成的推理,没有人类科目或私人记录. 专长标签在部署前需要特定任务验证,因为一个角色可以不可预测地改变模型行为. 训练使用学生和教师前传通行证,而推论仅使用适应学生及其普通的即时通行证.
